sources.entry: Musicer - A retro local music player that supports multiple formats and AI control.

summary.name: Musicer
summary.one_liner: A lightweight macOS local music player for playing audio files from your computer, with an MCP interface so AI clients can control playback.
use_cases: play local music files on a Mac
play FLAC, WAV or AAC files without a streaming service
control music playback from an AI assistant
show what is playing and read lyrics via an AI client
keep a small player window or status bar control while working
summary.what_it_does: Musicer is a small music player for macOS focused on local audio files. It supports common formats including MP3, AIFF, AMR, WAV, CAF, AAC, AC3, FLAC, M4R and M4A. The player has a waveform progress bar, customizable theme color, and a one-click switch between Mini, Standard and Large Cover layouts. It can also be shown and controlled from the status bar. The app supports MCP (Model Context Protocol), so an AI client such as Claude, Cursor or Grok can search, play, pause, skip and read the current track, including lyrics, in natural language. The App Store listing shows a 4.2 MB download, version 3.12.1, and interface languages including English, Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
notable: MCP support lets AI clients like Claude, Cursor or Grok control playback and read lyrics
Waveform progress bar and Mini / Standard / Large Cover player modes
Developer states it collects no data from the app
